description: Translation contract for The Comp Desk. Read by scripts/generate-translations.mjs and injected into the model's system prompt for every batch. Human reviewers should treat `terms[].translations` as the approved wording for a locale — once a slot is filled, the generator is told to use it verbatim.

rules.placeholders: Never translate, reorder the characters of, or add spaces inside a {placeholder}. Copy each one exactly as it appears in the source, including case. You may move a placeholder within the sentence when the target language's word order requires it, but every placeholder in the source must appear exactly once in the translation.
rules.register: Write for an injured worker with no legal training, reading on a phone, possibly under stress. Use the plainest everyday words the language allows. Prefer the polite-but-direct second person that a public-service agency would use (usted / vous / вы / 존댓말). Never use legalese where a common word exists.
rules.brevity: UI labels must stay short — buttons and tabs should not grow more than about 1.5x the English character count, or they break the layout. Prefer a shorter accurate word over a longer literal one.
rules.legalTerms: New York Workers' Compensation terms of art are legally meaningful. When a term appears in `terms` below, translate the concept plainly and keep the English term or abbreviation in parentheses on first use, e.g. Spanish: 'salario semanal promedio (Average Weekly Wage, AWW)'. Never invent an abbreviation in the target language.
rules.doNotTranslate: Items in `doNotTranslate` are product names, agency names, statute citations, and official form numbers. Reproduce them character-for-character in Latin script even in Arabic, Urdu, Bengali, Korean, and Chinese text — a worker has to match them against a paper form.
rules.punctuation: Use the target language's own punctuation and quotation marks. Keep the source's sentence count. Do not add exclamation marks the source does not have.
rules.currencyAndDates: Leave currency symbols, amounts, and date formats exactly as the source renders them — they are produced by code, not copy.
rules.noEmbellishment: Translate only. Do not add explanations, disclaimers, honorifics, or marketing language that is not in the source string.
rules.rtl: For ar and ur, write natural right-to-left text. Do NOT insert directional control characters or <bdi> tags yourself — write clean prose with the do-not-translate tokens verbatim, and scripts/i18n/isolate-rtl.mjs wraps them mechanically as a post-pass. CORRECTION, 2026-07-27: the previous wording said Latin terms 'will render correctly via bidi'. That is FALSE and it is the single most expensive thing to get wrong here. Measured in-browser: a Latin token reorders whenever it STARTS with a neutral character or a digit. 'C-3' and 'WCL §15(3)' are safe because they start with a strong Latin letter; '§15(3)' renders ')3(15§' and '400.1-OC' renders 'OC-400.1' — a DIFFERENT, entirely plausible form number that a worker would then fail to match against paper. This site is explanatory legal prose dense with citations, so the exposure is far larger here than in the app's short UI labels.
rules.isolationMechanism: THE SITE USES <bdi> TAGS. The generator injects HTML (byte-offset substitution into the page source), so a <bdi> element renders as an element. The APP uses U+2068 FSI / U+2069 PDI characters instead, because its h() helper renders through textContent/createTextNode and an HTML tag there would be shown to the user as the literal text '<bdi>'. Two repos, two renderers — do not unify them, and do not copy an RTL catalog from one to the other.
rules.arrows: Write the arrow that points in the READING direction: '→' in LTR locales, '←' (U+2190) in ar and ur. The Unicode bidi algorithm mirrors paired brackets and quotation marks automatically but does NOT mirror arrow glyphs, and no stylesheet can flip a character. Author '←' from the start rather than fixing it later.
rules.unverifiableTerms: Nobody on this project reads Arabic or Urdu. Do not coin legal terminology in either. Where a term of art has no settled rendering, state the concept plainly and keep the English term — the standard already applied to ht and ko. Every ar/ur string ships translationsReviewed:false until a native-speaker pass.

doNotTranslate: New York State Workers' Compensation Board

terms.definition: The worker's average gross weekly earnings before the injury; every cash benefit is calculated from it.

translations.es: salario semanal promedio (Average Weekly Wage, AWW)
translations.ru: средняя недельная заработная плата (Average Weekly Wage, AWW)
translations.bn: গড় সাপ্তাহিক মজুরি (Average Weekly Wage, AWW)
translations.ht: salè mwayen chak semèn (Average Weekly Wage, AWW)

terms.definition: A fixed number of weeks of benefits for permanent loss of use of an arm, leg, hand, foot, eye, ear, or other listed body part.

translations.es: pérdida permanente del uso de un miembro (Schedule Loss of Use, SLU)
translations.zh-Hans: 肢体功能丧失赔偿（Schedule Loss of Use，SLU）

translations.bn: নির্ধারিত ব্যবহার ক্ষমতা হ্রাস (Schedule Loss of Use, SLU)

terms.definition: The percentage by which a permanent non-schedule injury reduces the worker's ability to earn wages.

translations.es: pérdida de capacidad para generar ingresos (Loss of Wage Earning Capacity, LWEC)
translations.zh-Hans: 工资收入能力丧失（Loss of Wage Earning Capacity，LWEC）

translations.ko: 임금 소득 능력 상실 (Loss of Wage Earning Capacity, LWEC)

terms.definition: An examination by a doctor chosen by the insurance carrier, not by the worker.

translations.ko: 독립 의료 검진 (Independent Medical Examination, IME)

translations.ko: 일시적 전체 장해 (Temporary Total Disability, TTD)

terms.definition: The worker can do some work right now, but less than before the injury.

translations.es: mejoría médica máxima (Maximum Medical Improvement, MMI)
translations.zh-Hans: 医疗状况已达最大改善（Maximum Medical Improvement，MMI）
translations.ru: точка максимального медицинского улучшения (Maximum Medical Improvement, MMI)

translations.ht: amelyorasyon medikal maksimòm (Maximum Medical Improvement, MMI)
translations.ko: 최대 의학적 호전 (Maximum Medical Improvement, MMI)

terms.definition: The workers' compensation insurance company (or self-insured employer) responsible for paying the claim. NOT a shipping company or a phone carrier — mistranslating this is the single most common error.
The worker's workers' compensation case before the Board.
A proceeding before a Workers' Compensation Law Judge, often held virtually.
Money the Board orders the carrier to pay the worker.
A voluntary agreement that closes all or part of a claim, usually for a lump sum. Keep the citation 'Section 32' in Latin script.
The date the injury happened, or the date of disablement for an occupational disease. It controls which benefit rates apply.

translations.es: fecha del accidente (date of accident, DOA)
translations.zh-Hans: 事故发生日期（date of accident，DOA）
translations.ru: дата несчастного случая (date of accident, DOA)
translations.ht: dat aksidan an (Date of Accident, DOA)

terms.definition: A fee approved by the Board and taken out of the worker's award — never billed to the worker up front.
The New York State rules that say which treatments are pre-authorized for a given body part.

translations.es: Pautas de Tratamiento Médico (Medical Treatment Guidelines, MTG)
translations.zh-Hans: 医疗治疗指南（Medical Treatment Guidelines，MTG）
translations.ru: Руководство по медицинскому лечению (Medical Treatment Guidelines, MTG)
translations.ht: Gid Tretman Medikal yo (Medical Treatment Guidelines, MTG)
translations.ko: 의료 치료 지침 (Medical Treatment Guidelines, MTG)

zh-Hant.method: OpenCC Simplified->Traditional script transform, scripts/i18n/derive-zh-hant.mjs, Converter({from:'cn', to:'twp'}) — TAIWAN standard WITH phrase conversion.
zh-Hant.note: Same language, same wording, different script. Never translate separately — it would cost money AND create two divergent catalogs. Corrected 2026-07-27: this said "variant t" and listed twp as a future option, but derive-zh-hant.mjs:21 has always used twp. 'twp' also swaps mainland vocabulary for Taiwanese (软件->軟體), which 't' does not — so the two are not interchangeable and the note mattered.

translationsReviewedNote: false = the wording in `terms[].translations` is an UNREVIEWED HINT, not approved copy, so the generator passes it as guidance rather than as a verbatim lock. Flip a locale to true only after a native speaker has reviewed it.
